text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we were locked in a mortal struggle 
until early this morning, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The hateful nemesis that blocks my path 
with such curved trajectories as parabolic 
arcs—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, being who I am, I made full use 
of every millimeter of the straight and 
took them down... *yaaaawn*."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O couldn't sleep well and 
didn't seem to get much rest...
